Citymaker.UI.Area.HowDraw: Click corners, then the first one
Citymaker.UI.Area.PointsNodes: Over a junction a corner snaps to the road node; two in a row follow the road. Alt: no snapping.
Citymaker.UI.Arrangement.Hint: Repeats in this order along the edges
Citymaker.UI.Build.GroupTip: On: it is built as one asset. Click it to select all of it; the bulldozer removes all of it. Off: built as separate pieces you click, change and bulldoze one at a time. Removing all of it then takes Remove in a piece's info panel. You can ungroup or group it again later from there.
Citymaker.UI.Build.KeepAreaTip: On: after building, the area stays selected and Citymaker stays open, so you can build something else there. Off: Build closes Citymaker.
Citymaker.UI.Building.Title: Building…
Citymaker.UI.Entrances.Title: Entrances
Citymaker.UI.Feature.NoRoom: No room for it in this area.
Citymaker.UI.Fit.NoRoomHint: Make the area bigger or turn other extras off.
Citymaker.UI.Info.Missing: Some assets it used are missing (a mod or asset pack was removed). Edit to replace them.
Citymaker.UI.Info.Modified: Changed with other tools since it was built. Editing rebuilds it from its design.
Citymaker.UI.Info.RemoveAsk: Remove all of it? Buildings that grew next to it stay.
Citymaker.UI.Info.UngroupAsk: Ungroup it? Its pieces are then clicked and bulldozed one at a time. Group again puts it back.
Citymaker.UI.Info.Ungrouped: Ungrouped: you click and bulldoze its pieces one at a time. Remove takes all of it.
Citymaker.UI.LauncherTip: Choose an area and turn it into a park, plaza, parking lot, streets… or your own mix.
Citymaker.UI.Legend.AllTip: Show every layer as it was
Citymaker.UI.Legend.RowTip: Hover: show only this on the map. Click: hide it.
Citymaker.UI.Legend.RowTipHidden: Hidden on the map. Click to show it.
Citymaker.UI.LockedHint: Click to let Randomize change it again.
Citymaker.UI.Make.Title: Pick what to make
Citymaker.UI.Manage.CantEdit: This was built by an older version and can only be removed.
Citymaker.UI.Manage.Hover: Click something you built to edit it
Citymaker.UI.Manage.RegroupTip: One thing again: a click selects all of it and the bulldozer removes all of it.
Citymaker.UI.Manage.RemoveText: Everything Citymaker built here (paths, surfaces, objects, roads it added) is bulldozed. Buildings that grew next to it stay.
Citymaker.UI.Manage.UngroupText: Its pieces become separate: click any tree, bench, path or surface to change it or bulldoze it on its own. The bulldozer then removes one piece at a time, so removing all of it gets hard: use Remove in a piece's info panel for that. You can group it again there.
Citymaker.UI.Manage.UngroupTip: Make its pieces separate, so you can click, change and bulldoze each one yourself.
Citymaker.UI.Marker.AlleyTip: A small road junction through the edge.
Citymaker.UI.Marker.TwoWayTip: Cars drive in and out here.
Citymaker.UI.Markers.BannerFor: Placing {0} — click on the outline. Right-click one to remove it.
Citymaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkItemTip: On: a crosswalk across the street here. Off: the path stops at the sidewalk.
Citymaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkTip: On: the entrances you place next get a crosswalk across the street (the path joins the road at a new junction). Off: the path stops at the sidewalk and the game joins it, with no crosswalk and no cut in the road. Each placed entrance has its own switch below.
Citymaker.UI.Markers.Hint: Click the outline to add; right-click one to remove.
Citymaker.UI.Markers.Note: Pick a type, then click the outline by a road.
Citymaker.UI.Markers.Placing: Click the outline by a road to place one. Right-click removes one. Esc when done.
Citymaker.UI.Mock.Timeout: Planning took too long and was stopped.
Citymaker.UI.ModeCitymakerTip: Make roads, parks, car parks, shops and zones in an area you pick.
Citymaker.UI.ModeOutgrowTip: The whole city's outgrow: each zone type's default, the brush, the map lens, the outgrow types and their numbers.
Citymaker.UI.MoveTip: Drag to move. Double-click to dock.
Citymaker.UI.NoSettings: No settings: adapts to the area.
Citymaker.UI.Painter.ThemeTip.zone3: Each building gets its zone type's outgrow type (Outgrow, its Defaults)
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Applied.Tip: The game uses this value for the build.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Attractiveness.Me: Draws tourists: adds to your city's tourism attractiveness.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Capacity.Meaning: How many nearby streets the park can serve before it gets crowded.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Entertainment.Mea: Wellbeing boost for residents within reach.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.KeepVanilla.Tip: Keeps every value inside what vanilla parks of a similar size use.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Leisure.Meaning: How much fun one visit gives a citizen looking for something to do.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.NoRoad: No road edge: only tourism applies.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Note: Only attractiveness reaches the game here. The others are saved with the build.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.NoteCompanion: A small hidden park building at the road edge carries these stats, like a vanilla park.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Outside: Some values are beyond what vanilla parks this size have; the city may feel unbalanced.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Range.Meaning: How far residents walk to enjoy the park (path cost, about metres).
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Shown.Tip: Needs the companion park building (road edge and setting); saved with the build.
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Title: Park stats
Citymaker.UI.ParkStats.Upkeep.Meaning: Monthly running cost a vanilla park this good would have.
Citymaker.UI.PickRecipe: Nothing picked yet: pick a category to start
Citymaker.UI.Picker.HoverHint: Hover to preview, click to use
Citymaker.UI.Places.Title: Places inside
Citymaker.UI.Polish.ApplyMessage: {0} building(s) in this city are outgrown with “{1}”. They are all outgrown again with its new settings, a few at a time in the background.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.ApplyMessage2: That is {0} buildings: every garden, yard and car park of theirs is planned and built again. It cannot be undone in one step (save the old settings as a copy first if you may want them back).
Citymaker.UI.Polish.ByZoneNote4: Each building gets the outgrow type its zone type has. Change them in Outgrow (the switcher at the top), or pick any type here to outgrow the area with it.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.ColorTip: Its colour on the map (the lens's Types) and in the charts.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.DeleteMessage2: Buildings outgrown with “{0}” keep how they look until they are outgrown again; zones that used it go back to their own.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.LauncherTip: Pick buildings and outgrow their gardens: shared fences and hedges, lawns or painted ground, planting, by theme.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.LiveTip: On: the buildings in the selection are outgrown again a moment after every change you make, and the selection stays. Remove outgrow puts them back.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.Name: Outgrow
Citymaker.UI.Polish.PlantingTip: What is planted and placed in the land: Garden (lawns, beds, a sand pit or a bench), Natural (wild ground, rocks, logs), Tidy (lawns, hedges, flower beds), Yard (worn ground, pallets, rubble). The rows below fine-tune it.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.PolishAll.ByZone3: Every building is outgrown with its zone type's default outgrow type, also the ones you brushed another type onto (zone types set to Off are left out). It runs in the background a few buildings at a time, so the game keeps running smoothly.
Citymaker.UI.Polish.SaveBuiltIn: Save: this is what {0} is from now on, everywhere it is used
Citymaker.UI.Polish.UnpolishAll.Message2: The outgrown buildings go back to how the game made them: fences, hedges and lawns back, the beds, paths, bushes and paving taken away (ground paint stays). It runs in the background a few hundred at a time.
Citymaker.UI.Preset.CantSave: This style can't be saved over
Citymaker.UI.Preset.DeleteText: Your style is removed. Builds stay as they are.
Citymaker.UI.Preset.ExportNote: Saved. Send this file to share your styles.
Citymaker.UI.Preset.ResetText: Your changes to this style are dropped.
Citymaker.UI.Preset.SaveAsTip: Save these settings as a new style
Citymaker.UI.Preset.SaveBuiltIn: Save over this style (reset any time)
Citymaker.UI.Preview.RealTip: See-through game models and textures, exactly what will be built.
Citymaker.UI.Preview.SketchTip: Fast outlines and dots. Best while drawing and trying things.
Citymaker.UI.ResizeHeightTip: Drag to make it taller or shorter. Double-click for full height.
Citymaker.UI.ResizeTip: Drag to make it wider or narrower. Double-click for the default width.
Citymaker.UI.Review.AckTip: Some changes stay after you remove the build (the amber tags). Click it to allow them.
Citymaker.UI.Review.ChecksSub: warnings and things to look at before building
Citymaker.UI.Review.PaintOnly: Ground paint stays when the build is removed.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.AllStopsTip: Lit when it stops at everything here. Click to turn them all on, or all off when they are all on.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.BlockTip2: A stroke stays in what the Paint bucket would fill where it started.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.BuildsTip: Keep off what you built with Citymaker.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.GapTip: Openings narrower than this count as closed, and places narrower than it are left out. 0 = off.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.LotsTip2: Keep off other lots (other mods, extractors).
Citymaker.UI.Rules.ReachTip: How far the fill may spread from where you click. In open land it fills a circle this size.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.RoadsTip2: Stop at the curb of every road, its junctions and turning circles.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.SmartTip: On: the brush stops at what you switch on below. Off: it paints over everything.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.SmoothTip: How smooth the painted edge is.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.SnapTip: Pulls painted edges this close onto a curb.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.StopsTip: What the area never covers, for every tool. Red on the map.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.ZoningBuiltTip: Keep off zoned cells that have a building.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.ZoningGridTip: Keep off the whole zone grid along the streets, even cells nobody zoned.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.ZoningTip: How much of the zoning the area keeps off.
Citymaker.UI.Rules.ZoningZonedTip: Keep off every zoned cell, built on or not.
Citymaker.UI.Tool.BucketTip2: Click to fill the land up to what it stops at. Shift+click adds more, right-click drops one.
Citymaker.UI.Tool.PaintTip: Brush the area on. Right-click erases.
Citymaker.UI.Tool.PointsTip2: Click corners, then the first one to close. Snaps to curbs, right angles and road nodes: two corners on road nodes follow the road between them.
Citymaker.UI.Version.Mismatch: Restart the game: Citymaker's files were updated while it was running.
Citymaker.UI.Walls.TracksTip: Train and tram tracks on the ground.
Citymaker.UI.Why.NotNow: Not available with the current settings
Citymaker.UI.Why.RestartForMode: Restart the game to use this: Citymaker was updated while the game was running.
Citymaker.UI.ZoneMix.EditTypeTip2: Opens this outgrow type in Outgrow's Edit tab: a change there is for every zone that uses it.
Citymaker.UI.ZoneMix.GridTip: Its lots, in zone cells (one cell is 8 m), the road along the bottom: the solid block is the smallest lot, the lighter one the biggest; each lot picks a size between. Click or drag near a corner to move it.
Citymaker.UI.ZoneMix.ModeEditTip: Nothing is zoned: the buildings in the area outgrow their lots, each zone type by its own settings (a type not listed: the first one's).
Citymaker.UI.ZoneMix.ModeZoneTip: The empty zone cells of the area get these zones, as lots that start at the road; the buildings there outgrow their lots too.
Citymaker.UI.ZoneMix.NoZones: No zoned buildings in the selection: pick an area with buildings.
Citymaker.UI.ZoneMix.OutgrowOnTip: On: this zone's buildings outgrow their lots with the outgrow type beside it. Off: they stay as the game makes them.
Citymaker.UI.ZoneMix.RoadTip3: Allowed road width: the roads this zone may line, by their width (two lanes 16 m, four lanes 24 m, six lanes 32 m). Its lots are only placed along roads in this range.
Citymaker.UI.Zoning.Sub2: zones, and how their lots outgrow
